content.value: Two thin lenses of focal lengths $f _ { 1 }$ and $f _ { 2 }$ separated by a distance d have an equivalent focal length of 50cm. The combination satisfies the conditions for minimum spherical aberration and is also achromatic. Find the values of $f _ { 1 } , f _ { 2 }$ , and d. Assume that both the lenses are of the same material.
